nodes.name: Every 5 minutes (P50 runner gates live access)

parameters.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ('OneDrive\Desktop\' + (-join (0x32,0xcc28,0x20,0xd504,0xb85c,0xc81d,0xd2b8,0x20,0xc544,0xce74,0xc774,0xbe0c | ForEach-Object {[char]$_})) + '\ohora-trend-catcher'); $runner=Join-Path $root 'raw_v2\p50_n8n_tick.ps1'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)){throw 'P50 integration runner unavailable.'}; & $runner; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

parameters.jsCode: const out=[]; for (const item of $input.all()) { const stdout=item.json.stdout; if(typeof stdout!=='string'||!stdout.trim()) throw new Error('P50 runner returned no JSON result'); let r; try { r=JSON.parse(stdout.trim()); } catch { throw new Error('P50 runner returned invalid JSON'); } const pages=Number.isInteger(r.committed_pages)&&r.committed_pages>=0?r.committed_pages:null; const failures=Number.isInteger(r.account_failures)&&r.account_failures>=0?r.account_failures:null; const storage=r.storage_verification&&typeof r.storage_verification==='object'?r.storage_verification:null; const offline=r.mode==='P50_OFFLINE'&&r.live_meta_called===false; const malformed=pages===null||failures===null||typeof r.mode!=='string'; const failed=r.action==='MANUAL_REVIEW'||malformed||(r.action==='LIVE_TICK_COMPLETE'&&(!storage||storage.status!=='verified')); const waiting=r.action==='WAIT_EXPLICIT_LIVE_APPROVAL'||offline||r.status==='no_ready_work'||r.status==='serial_busy'; const state=failed?'manual_review':failures>0?'attention':pages>0?'collection_progress':waiting?'waiting':'manual_review'; const alertRequired=state==='manual_review'||state==='attention'; const alertCode=state==='manual_review'?'runner_or_storage_review':state==='attention'?'account_failures':null; out.push({json:{state,action:r.action||'unknown',mode:r.mode||'unknown',status:r.status||null,committed_pages:pages,recovered_pages:Number.isInteger(r.recovered_pages)?r.recovered_pages:null,account_failures:failures,attempted_steps:Number.isInteger(r.attempted_steps)?r.attempted_steps:null,live_meta_called:typeof r.live_meta_called==='boolean'?r.live_meta_called:null,storage_verification_status:storage?storage.status:null,receipt_delta:storage&&Number.isInteger(storage.receipt_delta)?storage.receipt_delta:null,durable_receipts:storage&&Number.isInteger(storage.durable_receipts)?storage.durable_receipts:null,alert_required:alertRequired,alert_code:alertCode}}); } return out;
